posix.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# codebase-memory-mcp search augmenter (Claude Code PreToolUse).
# NOTE: the legacy filename is kept for zero-migration upgrades.
# Despite the name this NEVER blocks a tool call - it only adds
# graph context. Any failure is silent (exit 0, no output).
BIN={{BIN}}
[ -x "$BIN" ] || exit 0
"$BIN" hook-augment 2>/dev/null
exit 0

windows.text:
@echo off
setlocal DisableDelayedExpansion
REM PreToolUse search and read coverage adapter installed by codebase-memory-mcp.
REM Fail-open: it never blocks or logs hook or prompt content.
set "BIN={{BIN}}"
if not exist "%BIN%" exit /b 0
"%BIN%" hook-augment 2>NUL
exit /b 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SessionStart hook: remind agent to use codebase-memory-mcp tools.
# Installed by codebase-memory-mcp. Fires on startup/resume/clear/compact.
cat << 'REMINDER'
CRITICAL - Code Discovery Protocol:
1. ALWAYS use codebase-memory-mcp tools FIRST for ANY code exploration:
   - search_graph(name_pattern/label/qn_pattern) to find functions/classes/routes
   - trace_path(function_name, mode=calls|data_flow|cross_service) for call chains
   - get_code_snippet(qualified_name) for exact symbol source (precise ranges)
   - query_graph(query) for complex Cypher patterns
   - get_architecture(aspects) for project structure
   - search_code(pattern) for text search (graph-augmented grep)
2. Use Grep/Glob/Read freely for text, configs, non-code files, and
   always Read a file before editing it.
3. If a project is not indexed yet, run index_repository FIRST.
REMINDER

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SessionStart hook: remind agent to use codebase-memory-mcp tools.
# Installed by codebase-memory-mcp. Fires on startup/resume/clear/compact.
cat << 'REMINDER'
Code Discovery Protocol:
1. Prefer codebase-memory-mcp tools first for structural code exploration:
   - search_graph(name_pattern/label/qn_pattern) to find functions/classes/routes
   - trace_path(function_name, mode=calls|data_flow|cross_service) for call chains
   - get_code(qualified_name) for exact symbol source in streamlined mode
   - query_graph(query) for complex Cypher patterns
   - search_code(pattern) for text/regex source search in an indexed project
2. Use Grep/Glob/Read freely for text, configs, non-code files, and
   always Read a file before editing it.
3. Graph-backed tools auto-index the server CWD or explicit repo paths when
   auto_index=true and under auto_index_limit. search_code needs an
   indexed project. Use _hidden_tools
   to reveal index_repository or get_architecture when explicit control is needed.
REMINDER

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SubagentStart hook: tell subagents to use codebase-memory-mcp tools.
# Installed by codebase-memory-mcp. Fires when any subagent is spawned.
# SubagentStart injects context via JSON additionalContext, not plain stdout.
cat << 'REMINDER'
{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SubagentStart","additionalContext":"Code discovery: prefer codebase-memory-mcp tools (search_graph, trace_path, get_code_snippet, query_graph, get_architecture, search_code) over grep/file-read for navigating code. Use Grep/Glob/Read for text, configs, and non-code files."}}
REMINDER

adapter_pi.tool_line: pi.registerTool({ name: '{{TOOL}}', run: (args, ctx) => call('{{TOOL}}', args, ctx?.signal) });
